description: This file contains utility methods used for handling entity condition expressions within the Apache OFBiz framework, specifically for operations like retrieving model fields and adding values to SQL buffers.

classes.name: EntityConditionUtils
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to facilitate condition expression operations such as retrieving fields from model entities and adding values to SQL buffers.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelField from a given ModelEntity by name, returning null if the ModelEntity is null.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Appends a value to an SQL buffer, utilizing SqlJdbcUtil's addValue method, conditioned on the non-nullity of the parameters.
